expected.name: Michael Kimble
expected.description: Michael Kimble is a Black gay anarchist prisoner and organizer in Alabama. Supporters describe the killing underlying his murder conviction as self-defense against a racist and homophobic attack; this is an attributed account, not a judicial finding of self-defense. Alabama's official inmate record identifies him as AIS 00138017 and lists Jefferson County murder case CC1987-001371, sentenced July 8, 1987, with state-prison admission July 9, 1987. As checked October 12, 2026, the department lists him at Fountain Correctional Center with life imprisonment and parole possible. No actual release is reported. The official admission date differs from supporters' November 12, 1987 account and must not be confused with an independently verified first arrest or pretrial detention day.
expected.body:
Official sentencing and state-prison admission

An authorized October 12, 2026 lookup in the Alabama Department of Corrections inmate search for the publicly documented AIS 138017 returned Michael Kimble, AIS 00138017. The individual record lists Jefferson County murder case CC1987-001371, sentenced July 8, 1987, and admission July 9, 1987. Those dates replace the unsupported November custody start without claiming to date first arrest or county-jail detention. The record lists current Alabama custody at Fountain Correctional Center, life with parole possible, and no actual release. A life-sentence sentinel and prospective parole-consideration date are not release evidence. The existing identified portrait is retained. Other offense rows are not automatically classified as political cases.
